map.居家给药：按体重换算对乙酰氨基酚混悬液体积，避免凭感觉倒: At-home dosing: convert the volume of paracetamol suspension by weight instead of pouring by eye
map.安全上限：由每日最大剂量 75 mg/kg 反推每日最多服用次数: Safety limit: work back from the maximum daily dose of 75 mg/kg to find the maximum number of doses per day
map.用药教育：提示间隔与总剂量，防止重复用药过量伤肝: Medication education: highlight the dosing interval and total dose to avoid double dosing and liver damage
map.算法：单次体积 = 体重(kg) × 剂量(mg/kg) ÷ 浓度(mg/mL): Algorithm: single volume = weight (kg) × dose (mg/kg) ÷ concentration (mg/mL); maximum doses per day = floor(daily limit 75 mg/kg ÷ single dose). Weight, dose and concentration must all be > 0. The result is a conversion reference only; actual dosing must follow the label and medical advice.
map.例1（体重 15kg、剂量 15mg/kg、浓度 32mg/mL）：单次 = 1: Example 1 (weight 15 kg, dose 15 mg/kg, concentration 32 mg/mL): single dose = 15×15/32 = 7.0 mL; daily limit = floor(75/15) = 5 doses (that is, once every 4 hours, no more than 5 doses a day). Example 2 (weight 10 kg, dose 10 mg/kg, concentration 32 mg/mL): single dose = 10×10/32 = 3.1 mL; daily limit = floor(75/10) = 7 doses.
map.浓度怎么看？: How do I read the concentration?
map.混悬液标签标 mg/mL（或 mg/5mL）；若标\"每 5mL 含 160mg: The suspension label shows mg/mL (or mg/5 mL); if it says "160 mg per 5 mL" the concentration is 32 mg/mL. Always check the concentration before converting the volume, as brands vary widely.
map.为什么有每日上限？: Why is there a daily limit?
map.对乙酰氨基酚单日累计超过 75mg/kg 有肝损伤风险；按上限反推次数可防重复用: A cumulative intake of more than 75 mg/kg of paracetamol in a day carries a risk of liver damage; working back from the limit to the number of doses helps prevent overdose from repeated dosing. Many cold medicines contain this ingredient, so the total must be added up.
